svg.text: Level 10 · Volcano Castle — The Ember Crown
29,000 world pixels · 24 encounters · 3 ordered Ember Seals · 2 refuges · exactly 3 achievement coins
Basalt = gray · Lava = orange · Beam = red column · Moving = blue outline · Collapsing = orange outline · Refuge = green flag
Establish a real fortress entrance, a lower guardhouse, guarded walls and a physically blocking gate after a meaningful moat crossing.
Explore linked cloisters, raise a gallery gate, cross damaged floors and climb a real balcony between distinct castle rooms.
Use visible furnace controls, real chain elevators, a maintenance treasury and a moving crossing, then time a furnace exhaust.
Recombine climbing, suspended masonry, timed machinery and an optional multi-stage high coin route with deliberate recovery balconies.
Approach the central throne through familiar architecture, face the required three-seal Warden and leave through a safe sunrise gallery.
Exact authored geometry, horizontally compressed by area. Continuous input proofs verify routes; human approval is still required.
